verdict.rationale: Avalara offers a dedicated E-Invoicing and Live Reporting (ELR) product that explicitly targets country-specific invoice formats, validations, and submission requirements, plus VAT Reporting for aggregating VAT obligations across jurisdictions — directly relevant to compliant invoice generation. But evidence is thin: no detail on which specific fields (VAT numbers, registration IDs, locale-specific formats) are populated, no example of an actual generated invoice, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that invoices produced via ELR meet local mandates end-to-end. Missing for 10: concrete field-level documentation of VAT/registration number handling, example compliant invoice output, and independent validation of e-invoicing mandate coverage across specific countries.
